text.title: Agency Risk Register Template — Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps for the Monday refresh, inside 30 minutes: recompute concentration from the 90-day billing export, update the scores of the six agency classes with their quantified details, walk the top five rows by score, decide every row at 15 or more with a dated mitigation or a signed acceptance, check owners and triggers on every row, move resolved rows to the closed tab with a lesson, then write the action note, record the minutes and validate.

step.name: recompute-concentration-from-billing
step.input: Billing or invoicing export for the trailing 90 days; the refresh date (a Monday).
step.action: Record `agency` and `refresh.date`. Fill `concentration` with `source: billing_export`, `trailing_days: 90`, `recomputed_on` = the refresh date and every client's `share`. Give every client above 20 percent a `revenue_concentration` row with `details.client` and `details.share`; score any client at 40 percent or more at 15 or higher.
step.decision-gate: Not a 3-25 person agency with a client above 20 percent or cross-border billing, or no Monday slot for 8 weeks: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml; an estimated share is not a recompute (r-concentration-90d-auto-score).

step.name: update-the-six-classes-with-numbers
step.input: CRM pipeline by stage; the ledger by currency; the contractor list; the credential and system inventory; the regulatory obligations list. Five minutes.
step.action: Update `rows[]` so each of key_person, fx_currency, contractor_classification, pipeline_thinness and regulatory has at least one row with its `details`: key-person `item`, `holder`, `remediation_owner`, `deadline`; FX `revenue_share_by_currency` and `cost_share_by_currency` from the ledger; each contractor's `jurisdiction`, `test`, `outcome` and `fix_due` when unresolved; pipeline `weighted_pipeline`, `monthly_cost_base`, `months_of_coverage` and `trigger_below_months`. Re-score `likelihood`, `impact` and `score` = their product.
step.decision-gate: "Some USD exposure", "a few contractors abroad", "pipeline feels thin" or an undated cross-training intention is rejected (r-cross-border-rows-quantified, r-pipeline-months-of-coverage, r-key-person-bus-factor-dated).

step.name: walk-the-top-five-rows
step.action: Walk the five highest rows: check each trigger against last week's events, confirm the owner still holds the row, and note what changed.
step.output: Trigger observations for the action note.
step.decision-gate: A project-level row (a scope slip, a late vendor, a bug) found in the top five is removed to that project's register (r-six-agency-risk-classes).

step.name: decide-every-row-at-15-or-more
step.input: Rows with `score` at 15 or more; the founder.
step.action: Set `response` on each: `mitigation` with `action`, `owner` and `due_date` inside the current week, or `acceptance` with `signed_by` (the founder) and `signed_on`.
step.decision-gate: A row at 15 or more with `response` null cannot close the refresh (r-score-15-action-or-signed-acceptance).

step.name: check-owners-and-triggers
step.action: Confirm each row has its 8 columns with `owner` a named person and `trigger` an observable event ("Client A misses two invoices in a row", "holder unavailable for more than 5 working days with no backup", "weighted coverage below 3 months").
step.output: Rows accepted for this week's register.
step.decision-gate: Owner "team" or "ops", or a trigger that cannot be checked in ten seconds, is rejected at the refresh (r-eight-column-row).

step.name: move-resolved-rows-to-the-closed-tab
step.input: Rows whose trigger can no longer fire or whose mitigation completed.
step.action: Move each to `closed[]` with `closed_on` and a one-line `lesson`; never delete a row.
step.decision-gate: A resolved row without a lesson stays open until it has one (r-closed-tab-not-delete).

step.name: write-the-action-note-and-validate
step.input: Trigger observations, responses and closures from steps 3 to 6; `templates/agency-risk-register-template.md.j2`. Ten minutes.
step.action: Write `refresh.action_note`, record `refresh.minutes` (scores_update, top5_walk, action_note, total) and `consecutive_overruns`; after two consecutive overruns set `split_or_prune_required: true` and split or prune before next Monday. Run `scripts/validate-agency-risk-register-template.py --file` on the register.
step.decision-gate: Total above 30 minutes is an overrun; the second in a row forces a split of project rows out or a prune (r-thirty-minute-monday).

list.item: Register validates via `scripts/validate-agency-risk-register-template.py` with no violation, including the Monday date, the timebox sum, the concentration rows and the in-week mitigation dates.
Every row at 15 or more has a dated mitigation or a founder-signed acceptance; every client above 20 percent has a row from this Monday's export.
The refresh closed inside 30 minutes, or the split or prune is scheduled before the next one.
